caps: Every lab on Earth searches for the cause.

bubs: No baby has been born in 9 months.
scenes.ticker: BREAKING: ZERO BIRTHS WORLDWIDE FOR 9 MONTHS  •  CAUSE UNKNOWN  •  YOUNGEST HUMAN IS NOW 9 MONTHS OLD  •

bubs: Whoever finds a cure... rules the world.
What if there is no cure?

caps: Toy shops, maternity wards, playgrounds: empty.

bubs: Ten years without a single birth.
The youngest humans are now celebrities.
Everyone wants to see the last kids.
scenes.ticker: 10 YEARS WITHOUT BIRTHS  •  LAST GENERATION TURNS 10  •  TOY INDUSTRY COLLAPSES  •

caps: 2045. The youngest person on Earth is 15.
They become the most famous people in the world.
2055. Not enough young people to work.
Who takes care of 6 billion elderly?

bubs: Robots will do the work now.

caps: Old nations try to grab the last young workers.
2070. Whole countries start to go silent.
The first great nation to vanish.

bubs: Nobody. Unless we leave a message.

caps: Roads crack. Trees grow through roofs.
All human knowledge, sealed in the Arctic.
A last message is launched into space.
2110. The youngest human is 80 years old.
The whole world is a retirement home.
The last humans live where the population was youngest.
Africa holds the last of humanity.
For the first time in 300,000 years... silence.
Cities are hills covered in forest.
As if we were never here.
